id: title:gantoine:add standard webhooks signing to the webhook destination

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Standard Webhooks support for HogQL destination execution, including request signing, identity preservation, and security checks against secret exposure.
review.reason: The observed hunks demonstrate a cohesive implementation and test group for adding Standard Webhooks support to HogQL destination execution. This includes adding webhook signing and identity preservation, adding E2E tests for webhook signing and signature verification, and adding a new utility module for webhook request signing. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement

observations.behavior: Adds Standard Webhooks support to HogQL destination execution.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows HogQL destinations to use Standard Webhooks for request signing, including webhook_id and secret_input, alongside existing AWS SigV4 support.

observations.behavior: Adds webhook_id and webhook-signature headers to outgoing requests.
observations.posthog_connection: Signs outgoing webhook requests with webhook-id, webhook-timestamp, and webhook-signature headers, matching the Standard Webhooks spec, while preserving webhook-id across retries.

observations.behavior: Adds E2E test for webhook signing and signature verification.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides end-to-end coverage for webhook signing and signature verification, including HMAC computation and header assertions.

observations.behavior: Adds Standard Webhooks signing and identity preservation to Hog Executor and webhook templates.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a dedicated test group for webhook signing, including HMAC signature generation and idempotency preservation across retries.

observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the signing secret is not exposed in the queue parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks that the plaintext secret is not stored in queue parameters, supporting the security model of keeping secrets encrypted or referenced rather than exposed.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional payload construction for standard_webhooks when a signing secret is provided.

observations.behavior: Adds a new utility module P1.F12.H1 in nodejs/src/cdp/utils/standard-webhooks.ts, including a 24-byte minimum secret length check, base64 decoding, and an HMAC-SHA256 signing function for webhook requests.
observations.posthog_connection: This module P1.F12.H1 implements Standard Webhooks signing, which P1.F13.H1 and P1.F14.H1 use as Hog bytecode fixtures. P1.F12.H1 could support webhook delivery and signing, while P1.F13.H1 and P1.F14.H1 are likely Hog bytecode fixtures for webhook-related Hog functions.
